properties.name: identifier_round_trip
properties.formal: ∀ s ∈ Ident (first ∈ [A-Za-z_$], rest ∈ [A-Za-z0-9_$], |s| ≤ 16, not keyword/synthetic): tokenize(s) = [Identifier(s)@span(0,len), Eof@span(len,len)]

properties.name: keyword_table
properties.formal: ∀ (t,kw) ∈ keyword table: tokenize(t,gnu=true)[0]=kw ∧ Display(kw)="'<canonical t>'" ∧ strict mode keeps C keywords, rejects bare GNU words

properties.name: int_literal_round_trip
properties.formal: ∀ v ∈ u64, suf ∈ {none,u,l,ll,ul,ull}, base ∈ {dec,hex,oct,bin}: tokenize(render(v,suf,base))[0] = c11_promote(v,suf,base) ∧ span=(0,len)

properties.name: promotion_boundaries
properties.formal: ∀ v ∈ {i32::MAX,+1, u32::MAX,+1, i64::MAX,+1, u64::MAX} × suffix × base: variant(tokenize(render(v,suf,base))) = documented table

properties.name: hex_float_exact_value
properties.formal: ∀ lit with ≤8 int + ≤4 frac hex digits, exp ∈ [-60,60]: bits(FloatLiteral(tokenize(lit))) = bits(mant · 2^(exp−4·frac_len))

properties.name: hex_float_huge_exponent
properties.formal: ∀ e ∈ {2^31, 2^32, 2^64, 10^20, negations}: value("0x1p"+e) = inf for e>0, = 0.0 for e<0

properties.name: integer_overflow_wraparound
properties.formal: ∀ base ∈ {hex,bin,oct}, digits 1..20: u64_payload(tokenize(render(digits,base))) = u128(digits) mod 2^64; decimal ≤ u64::MAX exact

properties.name: escape_sequences_reference
properties.formal: ∀ documented escape (simple | octal 1..3 digits | hex | \u/\U cp): char/string value = independent table value; multichar 'AB' = 0x4142 (int-typed, sign-extended)

properties.name: whitespace_invariance
properties.formal: ∀ safe token list T, separator assignments S1,S2 ∈ {spaces,tabs,newlines,//,/**/}⁺: kinds(tokenize(render(T,S1))) = kinds(tokenize(render(T,S2))) = T ++ [Eof]

properties.name: span_invariants_bounded_input
properties.formal: ∀ s ∈ UTF-8* with |s| ≤ 64: tokenize(s) yields terminal Eof@span(len,len) and monotone in-bounds spans

properties.name: imaginary_suffix_combinations
properties.formal: ∀ documented integer/float imaginary suffix combos (i/I/j/J before/after f/F/l/L, u^a·l^b·j): variant + value per documented tables

properties.name: surrogate_fallback_and_string_families
properties.formal: '\ud800' → U+FFFD (narrow packed 0xEFBFBD, wide 0xFFFD); L"\uXXXX" stores code point; u8"..." ≡ narrow; u"..." → Char16StringLiteral; u'x' → IntLiteral(cp)

properties.name: unknown_char_run_terminates
properties.formal: ∀ n ≥ 1: tokenize("ÿ"×n) terminates and ends with Eof
properties.counterexample: lex "\u{00FF}"×4000 → fatal runtime error: stack overflow, aborting (SIGABRT); 2000 passes

properties.name: unterminated_comment_consumed_to_eof
properties.formal: ∀ s ending in an unterminated /*: tokenize(s) = tokens-before-comment ++ [Eof]
properties.counterexample: lex "int /* gone" → [Int, Identifier("e"), Eof], expected [Int, Eof]

bugs.summary: Hex float literals wider than 64 bits silently evaluate to 0.0
bugs.impact: Programs using large hex-float constants (e.g. exact 2^64) silently compile with 0.0 — silent wrong-code.
bugs.fix: Parse hex digits into u128 (or accumulate into f64 with running scale, or reuse parse_long_double_to_f128_bytes) instead of u64::from_str_radix(...).unwrap_or(0) in lex_hex_float (scan.rs:242,244).
bugs.documentedBehavior: README:181 "Hex floats follow the C99 format 0x<int>.<frac>p<exp> and are converted via: value = (int_part + frac_part) * 2^exp"

bugs.summary: Hex float exponent truncated to i32 / parse-overflow aliases to exponent 0
bugs.impact: Valid-but-pathological hex float constants silently mis-evaluate (1.0 instead of inf/0.0).
bugs.fix: Keep exponent in i64 and scale with overflow-aware logic (clamp to ±1100 before powi or chunked multiplication with inf/0 short-circuit); never let an unrepresentable exponent alias to 0 (scan.rs:235,249).

bugs.summary: Integer literals larger than u64::MAX silently evaluate to 0 (all bases)
bugs.impact: Oversized constants (hash/mask tables) silently become 0 — GCC keeps the wrapped value with a diagnostic.
bugs.fix: Parse digit strings into u128 and truncate to u64 (modular accumulation) and emit a diagnostic when the value exceeds ULLONG_MAX (scan.rs:199,286,314,371).

bugs.summary: Stack overflow (process abort) on a run of unknown non-ASCII characters
bugs.impact: Robustness/DoS — ~3 KB of non-ASCII garbage outside comments/strings aborts the compiler (SIGABRT).
bugs.actual: fatal runtime error: stack overflow, aborting (threshold ≈4000 chars on a 2 MiB thread stack)
bugs.counterexample: lex "\u{00FF}"×4000 → fatal runtime error: stack overflow, aborting (SIGABRT); 2000 passes
bugs.fix: Replace the per-character recursion (return self.next_token()) in lex_punctuation's unknown-char branch with an iterative skip loop (scan.rs:1173).
bugs.documentedBehavior: scan.rs:1167 "Non-ASCII or unknown character: skip any remaining bytes of a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence (including PUA-encoded bytes from non-UTF-8 source files) and continue tokenizing."

bugs.summary: Unterminated block comment leaks its last byte as a token
bugs.impact: A file ending in an unterminated comment injects a phantom token (its last byte) into the stream.
bugs.counterexample: lex "int /* gone" → [Int, Identifier("e"), Eof], expected [Int, Eof]
bugs.fix: Change the block-comment loop bound from while self.pos + 1 < len to while self.pos < len so the scan reaches end-of-input (scan.rs:110).
bugs.documentedBehavior: README:158 "Ignored by the lexer: ASCII whitespace bytes, GCC-style line markers ..., Line comments ..., Block comments (/* to */)"
